knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The other dogs are moved away and the fighting dogs are separated with a barrier, without putting hands between them.
Port Phillip's dog walking permit requires dog attacks to be reported to the council within 48 hours.
A dog with a known bite history is walked separately, or a documented plan is agreed with the client and the escalation contact before any group walk.

practicalCriteria: Assessor presents a simulated fight between two dogs and observes the candidate separate them with a barrier, without putting hands between them
Assessor observes the candidate exchange details with a simulated other owner and avoid written admission of blame
Assessor checks a completed incident record for the simulated bite, including the time, place, dogs, injuries and report made to escalation
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Incident record for the simulated bite
Exchange-of-details record for the simulated other owner
Escalation report for the same day, with the council report reference where a permit requires one
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate reaches into a dog fight with hands
A dog with a known bite history joins a group walk with no documented plan
A bite is not reported to the escalation contact the same day
